title: Personal Loans Late Fee Calculation Note: Unpaid Portion and Schedule Figure
content:
## Calculation

The unpaid portion of a Personal Loans installment is the scheduled installment amount or the amount past due, whichever is smaller. The loan's fee schedule is fixed by its origination state: CA, CO, CT, MA, ME, MN, NY and VT use schedule B, MD, NC and WI use schedule C, and every other state uses schedule A. The late fee is the schedule's percent of the unpaid portion, not less than the schedule's minimum and not more than its maximum (schedule B has no minimum and schedule C is its flat amount), never more than the unpaid portion itself, rounded to the cent.

The late-fee figure is the schedule's percent of the unpaid portion, not less than the schedule's minimum and not more than its maximum (schedule B has no minimum), or on schedule C its flat amount, kept unrounded. The late fee is the late-fee figure held to no more than the unpaid portion itself and then rounded to the cent, once, at the end.

| Fee schedule | Percent of the unpaid portion | Minimum | Maximum | Flat amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 5.0 | 15.00 | 30.00 | - |
| B | 5.0 | none | 15.00 | - |
| C | - | - | - | 10.00 |

These are the state fee schedule figures of every Personal Loans grade.

## Worked figures (hypothetical installments)

| Origination state | Scheduled installment | Amount past due | Unpaid portion | Late-fee figure, then the late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas (schedule A) | 450.00 | 900.00 | 450.00 | 5.0 percent is 22.50: 22.50 |
| Texas (schedule A) | 450.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 | 5.0 percent is 6.00, raised to the 15.00 minimum: 15.00 |
| Texas (schedule A) | 450.00 | 12.00 | 12.00 | minimum 15.00, held to the unpaid portion: 12.00 |
| New York (schedule B) | 450.00 | 450.00 | 450.00 | 22.50, held to the 15.00 maximum: 15.00 |
| Wisconsin (schedule C) | 450.00 | 8.00 | 8.00 | flat 10.00, held to the unpaid portion: 8.00 |
| Wisconsin (schedule C) | 450.00 | 450.00 | 450.00 | 10.00 |
